title: Staged cutover and comms blueprint for model-tag compatibility migration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Define a staged cutover plan, detailed comms timeline, and release-notes coordination for migrating customers from legacy model tags to the new versioned model-tagging schema. This ticket centralizes the PM actions needed to: 1) publish migration guides and assisted migration options, 2) align engineering, design, and support on rollout blocks and telemetry, and 3) prepare release notes, console banners, and in-product SDK deprecation warnings. Outcome: lower-friction migrations, measurable reduction in compatibility incidents, and consistent external messaging.
acceptance_criteria: Public migration guide published and linked from docs site
Release notes draft reviewed and approved by Eng and Legal
Console banner and SDK deprecation warnings implemented in a canary environment
Automated telemetry emits two metrics: legacy_tag_usage and migration_flow_completion
Support playbook and escalation matrix published and CS trained

communication_plan: T-30 days: Internal kickoff + engineering readiness review (all stakeholders)
T-21 days: Draft release notes ready for review; blog skeleton and support samples drafted
T-14 days: Docs + migration guide published in staging; design assets finalized
T-7 days: Console banner copy locked; SDK warning shipped to canary users
Launch day: Public release notes, docs live, console banner enabled, automated email to impacted customers
T+7 days: Follow-up customer outreach to those who started migration flows but didn’t complete
T+30 days: Deprecation reminder emails and final sunset window announced to remaining customers
timeline: 2026-04-15: Engineering feature freeze for migration flags
2026-05-07: Canary rollout of SDK warning and console banner
2026-06-01: Begin enforced fallback for legacy tags (soft-sunset window starts)
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Preparation: telemetry, migration guide, internal playbooks
Phase 1 - Canary: small subset of customers see warnings and console prompts
Phase 2 - Broad opt-in: banner + email + release notes push to all customers
Phase 3 - Soft-sunset: limited enforcement with clear fallback behavior
Phase 4 - Enforcement: legacy-tag behavior disabled with documented alternatives
metrics: legacy_tag_usage (daily): baseline and drop over migration window
risks: Incomplete telemetry leads to blind spots during cutover
Misaligned messaging across channels causes customer confusion
SDK consumers upgrade lag and increased support load
Legal concerns around SLA changes delay public messaging
Unexpected perf regressions when new tag parsing enabled
